content: In this section we focus on the comparison of scores for the Russian dataset. The classifier for Russian had to choose between fewer classes (two or three), which made the scores higher and more consistent than for the English dataset. Overall, we see improvements in the scores for the majority of words, which proves that lemmatization for morphologically rich languages is beneficial.
